info.long_name: Patients with a Strep Throat Diagnosis
info.short_description: Quarterly count of patients with a strep throat diagnosis (J02.0, J03.00, J03.01).
info.long_description: Quarterly count of patients with a strep throat diagnosis, including streptococcal pharyngitis (J02.0), acute streptococcal tonsillitis, unspecified (J03.00), and acute recurrent streptococcal tonsillitis (J03.01). Data from Epic Cosmos, which contains de-identified data from 300M+ patients across 1,600+ hospitals. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic and imputed as 5; see epic_n_strep_throat_suppressed_flag. Quarters only partially covered by the exported date range are dropped, so every value covers a full calendar quarter. Population base per SlicerDicer session 2809857: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America and Has Any Encounters - the denominator is all patients with any encounter, NOT emergency department visits only.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} patients had a strep throat diagnosis.

info.long_name: Suppression flag for the strep throat patient count
info.short_description: Indicates whether the strep throat patient count was suppressed and imputed.
info.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the cell (a count of 10 or fewer, reported as "10 or fewer" or left blank) and epic_n_strep_throat was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. The flag is computed before imputation, so it records what the source withheld rather than what the ingest wrote.

info.short_description: Quarterly total patient count used as the denominator for the strep throat percentage.
info.long_description: Quarterly total count of patients, used as the denominator for epic_pct_strep_throat. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic and imputed as 5; see epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag. Population base per SlicerDicer session 2809857: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America and Has Any Encounters - the denominator is all patients with any encounter, NOT emergency department visits only.

info.long_name: Suppression flag for the total patient count
info.short_description: Indicates whether the total patient count was suppressed and imputed.
info.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the denominator cell (a count of 10 or fewer, reported as "10 or fewer" or left blank) and epic_n_patients was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. Where this flag is 1, epic_pct_strep_throat is left missing rather than computed from an imputed denominator.

info.long_name: Percent of Patients with a Strep Throat Diagnosis
info.short_description: Quarterly percent of patients with a strep throat diagnosis (J02.0, J03.00, J03.01).
info.long_description: Quarterly percentage of patients with a strep throat diagnosis, computed as epic_n_strep_throat / epic_n_patients * 100. Diagnosis codes include streptococcal pharyngitis (J02.0), acute streptococcal tonsillitis, unspecified (J03.00), and acute recurrent streptococcal tonsillitis (J03.01). Where the numerator was suppressed it is imputed as 5 before the percentage is computed. Where the denominator was itself suppressed the percentage is left missing, because dividing by the imputed denominator of 5 would assert a meaningless value; those cells still carry a suppression flag of 1. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer. Population base per SlicerDicer session 2809857: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America and Has Any Encounters - the denominator is all patients with any encounter, NOT emergency department visits only.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of patients had a strep throat diagnosis.

info.long_name: Suppression flag for the strep throat percentage
info.short_description: Indicates whether the strep throat percentage was affected by suppression.
info.long_description: 1 when either component of the percentage was suppressed by Epic Cosmos: a suppressed numerator (imputed as 5, percentage still computed) or a suppressed denominator (percentage left missing). 0 when both components were reported by the source.

epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. The dataset includes emergency department visits, diagnoses, immunizations, laboratory results, and other clinical data. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed. Coverage extends across all U.S. states and territories. Note that county-level and city-level stratifications could differ markedly in total sample size due to high levels of missingness of county data in some states.
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'
